learning_objective: 🎯 We will look at a beautiful picture, learn new words, and talk about what we see!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We look at the big picture carefully. We point at things and say their names out loud. It is like a fun game of I-Spy!
What are the children doing in the picture? We talk about it with our friends. We use simple and small sentences.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Magic Picture
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a beautiful park on a piece of paper. Color it with your favorite crayons and tell your family a story about it!

quick_recap: ⭐ We looked at a fun picture and found many hidden things.
⭐ We learned how to say the names of things in English and Hindi.
